mapper.sql: id, guid, device_guid, name, physical_type, status, endpoint, root_path, capacity_bytes, used_bytes, ext_config, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hydra_volume_physical (guid, device_guid, name, physical_type, status, endpoint, root_path, capacity_bytes, used_bytes, ext_config) VALUES (#{guid}, #{deviceGuid}, #{name}, #{physicalType}, #{status}, #{endpoint}, #{rootPath}, #{capacityBytes}, #{usedBytes}, #{extConfig})
mapper.update: UPDATE hydra_volume_physical SET name = #{name}, device_guid = #{deviceGuid}, physical_type = #{physicalType}, status = #{status}, endpoint = #{endpoint}, root_path = #{rootPath}, capacity_bytes = #{capacityBytes}, used_bytes = #{usedBytes}, ext_config = #{extConfig} WHERE guid = #{guid}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM hydra_volume_physical WHERE status != 'DELETED' ORDER BY id ASC
